activity_statements.statement: provides integrated specialty medical care to 1.3 million patients from 130+ countries annually across campuses in Minnesota, Arizona, and Florida
operates as the largest integrated not-for-profit medical group practice in the world, using collaborative team-based diagnostic and treatment approaches
conducts clinical research and translational medicine including clinical trials and community-engaged research to produce earlier diagnoses and new treatments
trains future physicians and health professionals through accredited medical education programs on its campuses
operates Mayo Clinic Platform to develop and deploy digital health technologies that change how care is delivered at scale
delivers more specialties ranked in the national top 3 than any other U.S. hospital, including complex multi-organ and rare-disease care

name_reality_gap: Name suggests a regional clinic; reality is the world's largest integrated medical group practice receiving complex referral cases from 130+ countries and operating a major digital health platform (Mayo Clinic Platform) alongside its clinical and research missions.
extraction_notes: Strong about page with clear activity data. Nonprofit entity — no 10-K. Platform initiative noted explicitly on about page.
